title: Raaz
desc: A large mansion situated in Nairobi, resounds with the shrieks of its owner Kumar - a young man of Indian origin. Night after night he is woken up by three dreams - a woeful melody of a damsel in distress.

title: Teri Payal Mere Geet
desc: Premi makes a living by selling poems to Benni and falls in love with a courtesan, Laila Jaan. However, he leaves her after finding the truth about her but tries to get back with her.
